summary: A big-city mayor said crowds had gathered outside her home with torches, and she now has a security detail.
realLife: A mayor said she and her family faced threats, including a crowd gathering outside their home with torches and pitchforks, and other plots she found hard to discuss. She now has a security detail most days and no longer runs or walks alone. She said she will not resign.
gates: The player holds a mayor's seat.
A protest against the town government has formed.
inGame: A protest against the town and a household can carry it as an office-doubt scene; a security detail needs a budget line.

turns.what: The crowd goes to city hall instead and the home stays quiet.
turns.writesBack: A protest record at the hall; no home note.

turns.what: The family stays at a relative's for a week.
turns.writesBack: A temporary move; household stress rises.
A vacancy record and a home talk.
